Emphasis is on the actual process of checking connections together, not posing for the camera. Human presence at left third, detailed switch and cable equipment at right two thirds. Natural cool overhead lighting, navy and pale blue palette, realistic skin and fabric texture, balanced exposure, softly blurred background with depth. Professional B2B editorial quality, no dramatic sci-fi lighting, no glowing effects, no hologram, no shields, no text, letters, visible brand logos, identifiable company marks, watermark, dashboards, or readable laptop content. Premium soft 3D editorial style, matte white and dark navy devices, electric blue #1768E8 primary detail and subtle cyan accents, soft grounded shadows on solid pale blue #F2F7FF background. Strong simple silhouettes and enough separation to be readable at 350 CSS pixels wide. No text, letters, digits, logo, watermark, decorative grid, orbit, unrelated symbols or neon. Entire scene contained with at least 8% edge margin. This is a conceptual illustration of assessment, design, supply, implementation and support, not proof of a real project.
